summary.text: Kate Gallup is the Democratic candidate for Michigan State Senate District 37, having defeated Mitchell Treadwell in the August 4, 2026 primary; she faces Republican incumbent John Damoose in the general election.
A Traverse City Central High School graduate who works as an educator, she describes a background in engineering, education and public service.

paragraphs.text: Gallup earned a graduate degree from the University of Michigan in 2008.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her campaign priorities include getting money out of politics, which she said she supported by collecting signatures for a ballot initiative, along with health care access through MICare and rules on data centers to protect land, water and utility costs.
She listed endorsements from 314 Action, the Leelanau Democrats and Planned Parenthood.
